verdict.rationale: ClickUp explicitly advertises an 'Automations' feature and workflow triggers from events, indicating a no-code automation capability exists, but the evidence pack gives only brief labels rather than details on building multi-step, conditional automations or a visual builder. Missing for 10: documentation of the automation builder UI/multi-step logic, examples of conditional triggers/actions, and independent hands-on corroboration of ease-of-use for non-coders.
